routes.name: Mauritania eVisa
routes.summary: The official ANRPTS portal issues electronic visas in 30, 90 and 360 day packages, valid at all international ports of entry.

other: Eligible nationalities, fees and documents were not shown on the page read. Check the ANRPTS help center before applying.

routes.name: Visa at the border
routes.summary: Travelers can present their passport to the visa authority at an airport or land border and pay the fee there. The fee page cites a 2017 circular, and the eVisa may have replaced this, so confirm before traveling.

other: Fee page is based on a 2017 circular. Confirm current rules and amounts.

fees.label: 30 day visa, Arab world and Africa (approx.)
30 day visa, rest of the world (approx.)

routes.processing: Visa categories run from 30 days up to 3+ years. Fees rise with length (up to 20,000 MRU Arab/Africa and 30,000 MRU rest of world for 3+ years).

routes.name: Bilateral visa waivers
routes.summary: Mauritania lists reciprocal visa waiver agreements. Many cover only diplomatic or service passports. Ordinary passport coverage was not clear on the page.

other: Listed countries without a diplomatic-only note: Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Mali, Senegal, Gambia, Niger, Cote d'Ivoire, Chad. The page does not say whether this covers ordinary passports or how long you can stay, so confirm with a Mauritanian embassy.
Diplomatic or service passports only: Morocco, Syria, Yemen, UAE, Spain, Turkey, Brazil, China, Iran.
